title: Gießerei announces +2.2 % on Volute casing HN 100-315
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Gießerei announces +2.2 % on Volute casing HN 100-315. Need: 700 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.
